interpretation: Native notification materially reduces local serial host bridge wait and eliminates periodic idle timers.
Script decoding is cached once per immutable package, but complete package verification showed no microbenchmark speedup.
Final 10-trial regular release group has workspace-ready p50=987ms/p95=1311ms; it followed an emulator restart.
The earlier regular baseline and final group were not interleaved in matched emulator states. No stable overall startup speedup percentage is established.
Diagnostic groups and groups overlapping tests or compilation are exploratory and are not pooled with regular release groups.
The failed 20-trial group is retained as incomplete and is not used as a completed comparison group.
ActivityCreateToWorkspaceReadyMs excludes process creation and is not Android TTFD.
ARM64 physical-device startup, Windows native notification teardown and low-end/large-dataset matrices were not measured.
